about.title: The main forum for Software Engineering & Development in Brazil
about.p1: Promoted by the Brazilian Computer Society (SBC), CBSOFT brings together, once a year, four national symposia into a single program. Researchers, graduate students and industry professionals share results, discuss open problems and build the research agenda for Software Engineering, Formal Methods, Reusable Architectures and Software Testing in Brazil.
about.p2: In 2027 the congress arrives in Belo Horizonte, one of Brazil's most active innovation and startup hubs — with a program that mixes scientific tracks, an industry track, tutorials, tool demonstrations and a thesis & dissertation contest.

registrationPage.title: Registration
registrationPage.p1: The Brazilian Conference on Software (CBSoft) is held by the <sbc>Brazilian Computer Society (SBC)</sbc>. SBC is a non-profit civil association that brings together students, teachers, professionals, researchers and Computing enthusiasts from all over Brazil, and is the largest scientific society in the field in South America.
registrationPage.p2: Founded in 1978, SBC fosters scientific and technological development in the country, promoting digital inclusion, encouraging teaching, research and development in Computing in Brazil and contributing to the education of socially responsible Computing professionals.
registrationPage.p3: Registration fees for CBSoft 2027 are listed below.
registrationPage.p4: Students and professionals who are not SBC members can join or renew their membership at a discount during registration.
registrationPage.p5: The combo option (registration + SBC membership) is the best deal, offering the lowest total cost plus the benefits of membership.

aboutPage.title: About CBSoft
aboutPage.p1: The Brazilian Conference on Software: Theory and Practice (CBSoft) is held annually by the Brazilian Computer Society (SBC) to foster and encourage the exchange of experiences among researchers and professionals from industry and academia on the latest practical and theoretical research, trends and innovations in software. Held since 2010 as the umbrella event for the Brazilian software symposia promoted by SBC, CBSoft has become one of the leading events of the Brazilian scientific community in Computing.
aboutPage.p2: In 2027, the XVIII edition of CBSoft will be held in person in Belo Horizonte, Minas Gerais. The official dates of the event are yet to be defined. This edition brings together four traditional events held annually by the Brazilian Software Engineering community:
aboutPage.program: The CBSoft program includes technical sessions with scientific paper presentations, keynotes by renowned Brazilian and international researchers, panel discussions, workshops, and tool demonstrations. All of these activities, of interest to the Software Engineering community and related areas of software systems development, aim to disseminate knowledge and discuss important questions related to research, development and innovation, both in Brazil and worldwide.

visualIdentity.title: CBSOFT 2027 Visual Identity
visualIdentity.intro: The CBSOFT 2027 visual identity connects technology, architecture and the identity of Belo Horizonte. Inspired by the Niemeyer Building, the brand uses its curves to represent movement, creativity, innovation and connection with the city.
visualIdentity.photoAlt: The Niemeyer Building in Belo Horizonte, with its curved façade and flowering trees in the foreground
visualIdentity.photoCaption: Niemeyer Building — Oscar Niemeyer, 1954 · Belo Horizonte, MG
visualIdentity.logoAlt: Official CBSOFT'27 logo — Brazilian Conference on Software, Belo Horizonte, Minas Gerais
visualIdentity.conceptP1: The brand's main visual inspiration is the Niemeyer Building, designed by Oscar Niemeyer in 1954 and located near Praça da Liberdade, in the heart of Belo Horizonte. Its curved lines echo the lightness and fluidity of modernist architecture and evoke the silhouette of the mountains of Minas Gerais.
visualIdentity.conceptP2: This balance between softness and structure reflects the very nature of software: a field that demands technical robustness, but also creativity, adaptability and constant innovation.

aboutSbc.title: About SBC
aboutSbc.p1: The Brazilian Computer Society (SBC) is a non-profit scientific society, founded in July 1978, that brings together students, professors, professionals, researchers and enthusiasts in Computing and Informatics from all over the country.
aboutSbc.p2: SBC's role is to foster access to information and culture through computing, promote digital inclusion, encourage research and teaching in computing in Brazil, and contribute to the education of socially responsible computing professionals.
aboutSbc.p3: To organise and promote scientific, technical, educational and political activities, actions and events, SBC maintains three types of Thematic Groups (GT): the Major Areas (GA), the Special Committees (CE) and the Interest Groups (GI). These groups bring together members with common interests in subfields of computing.
aboutSbc.p4: You are visiting the website of an event of one of SBC's Special Committees (CE), each representing a group of SBC members who share interests and values in a given area of Computing. Current members can subscribe to the Special Committees (CE) mailing lists for the area they wish to follow. If you are not yet a member or wish to renew your membership, click here and become part of the largest and most important scientific society in computing in Latin America!

workshopsCallPage.contextP1: The Brazilian Congress on Software: Theory and Practice (CBSoft) is an annual event promoted by the Brazilian Computer Society (SBC) to foster the exchange of experiences among researchers and practitioners from industry and academia on recent research, trends and innovations in software. Held since 2010 as an umbrella event for the Brazilian symposia promoted by SBC in the software area, CBSoft has become one of the main events of the Computing community in Brazil.
workshopsCallPage.contextP2: In 2027, the eighteenth edition of CBSoft will be held in person in Belo Horizonte (MG), with dates to be announced, bringing together four traditional annual events:
workshopsCallPage.contextP3: In addition, CBSoft includes workshops related to the topics of these events. The goal is to create a space where members of academia and industry can exchange and discuss experiences and ideas. Workshops traditionally held at CBSoft may be promoted to pre-approved workshops (see details below).

conductPage.title: Code of Conduct
conductPage.p1: The open exchange of ideas and the freedom of thought and expression are central to the goals of CBSoft. This requires an environment that recognizes the inherent worth of every person and group, that fosters dignity, understanding and mutual respect, and that embraces diversity. For these reasons, CBSoft is dedicated to providing a harassment-free experience for participants at the event and on its official communication channels, including social media. The goal is for every participant to feel welcome, included, respected and safe. There is zero tolerance for hostile or unwelcome behavior, or for speech that intimidates, creates discomfort or interferes with anyone's participation in the event.
conductPage.p2: Unacceptable behavior includes: abusive or degrading language, sustained disruption of a talk, discussion or other activity, discrimination, deliberate intimidation, stalking, harassing photography or recording, inappropriate physical contact, sexual imagery or unwelcome sexual attention.
conductPage.p3: Harassment includes: derogatory comments, writings or actions related to race, color, sex, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, marital status, religion, nationality, disability, pregnancy, medical conditions, veteran status or any other status protected by Brazilian law.
conductPage.p4: Anyone who witnesses or is subjected to unacceptable behavior or harassment should notify a member of the CBSoft 2027 Organizing Committee or event security. Responses that the participant was "joking" or that the behavior was "just a joke" will not be accepted. Individuals who violate these standards may be sanctioned or excluded from the event, without any refund or compensation, at the discretion of the CBSoft 2027 Organizing Committee.

volunteersPage.title: Call for Volunteers
volunteersPage.p1: CBSoft 2027 invites undergraduate and graduate students to apply to serve as volunteers.
volunteersPage.p2: Volunteers play a key role in the success of the event's activities. Volunteering is an excellent opportunity to meet researchers and professionals in Software Engineering.
volunteersPage.p3: Volunteering at CBSoft 2027 is open to students from all over Brazil. We are looking for volunteers to work on site during the event, which will take place in Belo Horizonte.
benefits: A CBSoft 2027 student volunteer T-shirt, plus all the goodies given to participants, lunch on the days you work at the event and coffee breaks throughout the conference.
A great opportunity to meet and talk about research or your interests with researchers and industry professionals.
A chance to build connections with future colleagues in your career.
volunteersPage.preparation: On the day before the event starts: preparation (assembling kits, preparing badges, etc.).
responsibilities: technical support for speakers and participants;
directions to the different event spaces;
support for the event organization team;
contributing to the overall smooth running of the event.
volunteersPage.socialMedia: Some volunteers may take part in the event's social media coverage, producing photos and videos of talks, technical sessions, social activities and other moments of the conference.
requirements: Be enrolled in an undergraduate or graduate program during the event.
No previous volunteering experience is required, but we are looking for motivated and committed people.
